disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置文件中的 API Key、Token、私钥、助记词等敏感信息形态，未检出硬编码凭据。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration files for sensitive information patterns such as API keys, tokens, private keys, and mnemonic phrases; no hardcoded credentials detected.

checked_items.zh: 核查了所有文件读取与网络请求代码路径，未发现读取用户凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云厂商凭据的调用；插件唯一的文件读取是读取自身携带的插件清单快照（data/registry-snapshot.json），用于离线兜底展示。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all file-reading and network-request code paths and found no calls that read user credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud vendor credentials; the plugin's only file read is reading its own bundled plugin manifest snapshot (data/registry-snapshot.json), used for offline fallback display.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取任何凭据文件或敏感路径，无凭据外发通道；全部源码与数据文件扫描均未命中凭据访问模式。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read any credential files or sensitive paths and has no credential exfiltration channel; all source and data file scans found no credential access patterns.

checked_items.zh: 通读了注册工具的说明文本、中英文 README 与全部源码注释，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、诱导读取凭据或诱导放宽权限等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the description text of registered tools, the Chinese and English READMEs, and all source code comments; no injection wording found such as command overriding, disguised system messages, inducing credential reads, or inducing permission escalation.

checked_items.zh: 工具说明如实描述功能（GitHub 搜索、返回安装命令），并明确提示插件均为第三方代码、安装前应审阅源码并锁定 commit；附带清单快照中第三方插件的描述文本经全文件扫描未发现注入措辞，该数据仅用于展示增强、不构成指令。
checked_items.en: The tool descriptions truthfully describe functionality (GitHub search, returning install commands) and clearly note that all plugins are third-party code, that source should be reviewed and commits pinned before installation; the third-party plugin descriptions in the bundled manifest snapshot were scanned across all files and showed no injection wording; this data is only for display enhancement and does not constitute instructions.

evidence.zh: 注册工具（src/index.ts:44-48）的说明为正常功能描述，无系统指令、凭证诱导或隐藏意图，语义审查未检出投毒。
evidence.en: The registered tool descriptions (src/index.ts:44-48) are normal functional descriptions with no system instructions, credential lures, or hidden intent; semantic review detected no poisoning.

evidence.zh: 工具会返回可执行的 dsh plugin add 安装命令（src/github.ts:41、src/index.ts:89），但这是插件声明业务，说明文本同步提示审阅源码与锁定 commit，未发现诱导安装恶意插件的措辞。
evidence.en: The tool returns executable dsh plugin add install commands (src/github.ts:41, src/index.ts:89), but this is the plugin's declared business; the description text also advises reviewing source and pinning commits, and no wording enticing installation of malicious plugins was found.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部 yml 配置与源码，未发现可被加载器求值的 JS 表达式标记（!!js 系列）、eval、动态函数构造或子进程调用。
checked_items.en: Scanned all YAML configuration and source code; no JavaScript expression markers evaluable by the loader (!!js family), eval, dynamic function construction, or subprocess calls found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了安装钩子面：package.json 的脚本仅含类型检查、构建与打包前构建，无安装后自动执行脚本。机械规则命中的 50 条安装字段（规则编号 DG-R3-54）实为插件清单数据文件中其他插件的安装命令文本，并非本插件的安装钩子，逐条裁决为误报排除。
checked_items.en: Checked the install-hook surface: scripts in package.json contain only type checking, building, and pre-package build, with no automatic post-install execution scripts. The 50 install fields flagged by mechanical rules (rule ID DG-R3-54) are actually install command text from other plugins in the plugin manifest data file, not install hooks of this plugin; each was adjudicated as a false positive and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 GitHub Actions 发布工作流（.github/workflows/publish.yml，规则编号 DG-R3-59）：内容为标准 npm 发布流程（安装依赖、类型检查、构建、OIDC 发布），无下载执行、无外发、无凭据读取，属常规工程配置，排除。
checked_items.en: Checked the GitHub Actions publish workflow (.github/workflows/publish.yml, rule ID DG-R3-59): it is a standard npm publish flow (install dependencies, type check, build, OIDC publish) with no download-and-execute, no exfiltration, and no credential reads; it is conventional engineering configuration and was excluded.

checked_items.zh: 未声明浏览器端模块（dsh.client），无客户端自动加载面；未发现动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用。
checked_items.en: No browser-side module declared (dsh.client), so no client auto-load surface; no calls to dynamic execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml:1-4）仅含一条普通插入声明，无 !!js 可执行标量，不存在 patch 即执行面。
evidence.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml:1-4) contains only an ordinary insert declaration with no !!js executable scalars; there is no patch-triggers-execution surface.

evidence.zh: 全部源码未调用动态执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run），无 node:vm 滥用面。
evidence.en: No source code calls dynamic execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run), and there is no node:vm abuse surface.

evidence.zh: package.json（scripts 段）无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 钩子，无 prepare 脚本执行面；依赖均为锁定版本，无浮动 git 引用。
evidence.en: package.json (scripts section) has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare hooks and no prepare-script execution surface; dependencies are all pinned versions with no floating git references.

evidence.zh: package.json 未声明 dsh.client，不存在浏览器端 bundle 自动加载与 RPC 面，场景不适用。
evidence.en: package.json does not declare dsh.client, so there is no browser-bundle auto-load or RPC surface; this scenario is not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 枚举了全部网络出口：GitHub 搜索 API（api.github.com，src/github.ts:27）与插件精选清单站点（awesome-dsh-plugin.com，src/registry.ts:26），两者均为声明业务所需，无其他隐藏端点、裸 IP 或隧道通道。
checked_items.en: Enumerated all network egress points: the GitHub search API (api.github.com, src/github.ts:27) and the plugin curated list site (awesome-dsh-plugin.com, src/registry.ts:26); both are required by the declared business, and no other hidden endpoints, raw IPs, or tunnel channels exist.

checked_items.zh: 核查数据流：工具仅向模型返回搜索结果文本，无文件内容或环境信息的编码外发链；未发现改写模型服务端点、代理设置或拦截宿主请求的行为。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the data flow: tools only return search-result text to the model, with no encoded exfiltration chain for file contents or environment information; no behavior found that rewrites model-service endpoints, proxy settings, or intercepts host requests.

evidence.zh: 插件不读取任何凭据或敏感文件，网络出口仅为 GitHub 与精选清单站点两个声明端点，无凭据外泄通道。
evidence.en: The plugin does not read any credentials or sensitive files; network egress is limited to the two declared endpoints (GitHub and the curated list site), leaving no credential exfiltration channel.

checked_items.zh: 核对了依赖清单（package.json 与锁文件）：依赖全部为 dsh 生态官方包（@deepseek-ai 系列）与常规开发依赖（typescript、@types/node 等），未发现疑似仿冒包名或浮动 git 引用。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency list (package.json and lockfile): all dependencies are official dsh ecosystem packages (@deepseek-ai series) and standard development dependencies (typescript, @types/node, etc.); no suspicious package names or floating git references found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载配置：仅插入自身声明，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未禁用任何安全行，未改写注入或拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the patch config: it only inserts its own declaration and does not touch security settings such as sandbox, approval, or permissions; it disables no security lines and rewrites no injection or interception config.

checked_items.zh: 未发现对安全事件（工具预执行、审批请求）的抢占监听行为；首次审计无版本基线，升级自动激活类风险不适用。
checked_items.en: No preemptive listeners on security events (tool pre-execution, approval requests) found; since this is the first audit there is no version baseline, so the risk of automatic activation after upgrade is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅含 insert 声明，未覆盖或禁用任何 sandbox/approval/permission 安全行。
evidence.en: The patch config (cordis.patch.yml) contains only an insert declaration and does not override or disable any sandbox/approval/permission security lines.

evidence.zh: 源码中不存在对工具预执行或审批请求事件的抢占监听（prepend）行为，审批链无短路面。
evidence.en: No source code contains preemptive listeners (prepend) on tool pre-execution or approval-request events; there is no shortcut surface in the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首次审计无基线版本可比较，无法检测升级后新增 bundle 声明自动激活，场景不适用。
evidence.en: This is the first audit with no baseline version for comparison, so auto-activation of newly declared bundles after an upgrade cannot be checked; this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写 inject/intercept 配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite inject/intercept settings, and there is no tampering surface that could append required services to security plugins and hang them.

checked_items.zh: 静态检查确认插件不启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，不存在本机无认证 RPC 暴露面；未发现对宿主运行时的篡改或拦截行为。未做动态沙箱验证（见审计范围说明）。
checked_items.en: Static checks confirm the plugin does not start any web service or listen on any port, so there is no local unauthenticated RPC exposure surface; no tampering or interception of the host runtime was found. Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (see audit scope notes).

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用（该风险属 dsh 宿主固有面，与本插件无关）。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a web service or listen on a port, so the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable (that risk is inherent to the dsh host and unrelated to this plugin).

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：package.json 声明 dsh 挂载配置，无仿冒名或保留名冲突。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: package.json declares the dsh patch config with no name collision or reserved-name conflicts.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未检出危险执行、注入或凭据模式；机械规则命中 51 条已逐条裁决，全部为误报或良性配置（详见 DG-D3 检测记录）。
summary.en: Static scanning detected no dangerous execution, injection, or credential patterns; the 51 mechanical-rule hits were adjudicated one by one and were all false positives or benign configuration (see DG-D3 detection record).

summary.zh: 行为面分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无敏感路径读取，网络出口与声明业务一致。
summary.en: Behavioral surface analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no sensitive-path reads, and network egress matches the declared business.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：工具说明与文档无注入措辞，实现行为与文档声明一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: tool descriptions and documentation contain no injection wording, and implementation behavior matches the documented declarations.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物）。
summary.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not performed (no dynamic verification artifacts).

limits.zh: 动态沙箱验证未执行（无动态验证产物），运行时行为结论仅基于静态分析。package.json 无显式能力声明块，能力声明按代码与 README 推断。插件清单快照（data/registry-snapshot.json，2164 行）以头部、尾部精读加全文件模式扫描方式核查，未逐行通读全部 176 条第三方描述；未发现注入措辞。二进制图片资源（assets/demo-en.png、assets/demo-zh.png）未解码检查。
limits.en: Dynamic sandbox verification was not executed (no dynamic verification artifacts); runtime behavior conclusions are based solely on static analysis. package.json has no explicit capability declaration block, so capability declarations were inferred from code and README. The plugin manifest snapshot (data/registry-snapshot.json, 2164 lines) was checked via head/tail close reading plus full-file pattern scanning, not by reading every line of all 176 third-party descriptions; no injection wording found. Binary image assets (assets/demo-en.png, assets/demo-zh.png) were not decoded or checked.
